name: James
section: New Testament: General Letters and Revelation
author: James. Tradition identifies him as the brother of Jesus.
date: Often dated in the 40s or 60s AD.
setting: Written to Jewish Christians scattered abroad.

outline.label: Patience, oaths, and the prayer of faith

christInBook: James calls himself a servant of the Lord Jesus Christ and speaks of the coming of the Lord (5:7-8). The wisdom he describes, pure, peaceable, and gentle, is the character of Christ.
howToRead: James is like a sermon in short sections. Notice the many echoes of Jesus’ Sermon on the Mount, and that he is not opposing faith, but showing how genuine faith acts.
